defs.def: the person in charge of a meeting, who tells people when they can speak, etc. （会议的）主席，主持人

ex.s: The chairman of the China Culture Promotion Society ___43___ (address) the opening ceremony.
ex.t: "作为国际茶日的主要推动者，作为茶的故乡和 ___44___ (large)茶叶生产大国，中国有 ___45___ (responsible)责任与其他国家合作促进茶产业的健康发展。

ex.s: Mr Titterton is chairman of the Omega Ensemble but has been the group’s official page turner for the past four years.
ex.t: 蒂特顿先生是Omega乐团的主席，但在过去四年里他一直是该乐团的官方翻谱员。

defs.def: the person in charge of a committee, a company, etc. （委员会的）委员长，主席；（公司等的）董事长

ex.s: After Dr Bethune’s death, Chairman Mao Zedong wrote an article in memory of him, in which he praised Dr Bethune as a hero to be remembered in China.
ex.t: 白求恩博士去世后，毛泽东主席为纪念他写了一篇文章，称赞白求恩博士是中国人铭记的英雄。

ex.s: For example, police officer is used instead of , instead of chairman, salesperson instead of , humankind instead of and postal worker instead of .
ex.t: 例如，使用警察而不是主席，使用销售人员而不是人类而不是邮政工作人员而不是。

ex.s: I decided to volunteer for this year's half- marathon after the chairman of the organizing committee visited my school.
ex.t: 组委会主席来我校参观后，我决定自愿参加今年的半程马拉松比赛。
